description: This file defines TypeScript type declarations and class interfaces for the SmartBuffer library, including options, class methods, and data reading/writing functionalities.

classes.name: SmartBuffer
classes.description: A class providing methods for reading, writing, inserting, and managing binary data in buffers, with support for various data types and encodings.
